topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I never thought I'd stumble upon this layer of surprise, the kind that upends the familiar paths of daily life. It started with an online thread, a shared interest that felt like the foundation of distant camaraderie. We had our own way of speaking, a language of memes and quick wit, miles apart but strangely close. Then, the revelation crept in—a glance at a profile, a shared connection, and suddenly, the digital veil lifts to reveal a local. It's one thing to chat in the abstract, where screens are a buffer. It’s another to realize the person behind the screen is just a neighborhood over. The thought swirls, blending the ease of the virtual with the complexities of the real. What now? The next steps are murky, the ground a bit less solid underfoot.
